gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Stencilia's curves stop short and leave generous gaps at their ends, giving the headline a cut-from-sheet, structural look. Atkinson Hyperlegible sits underneath in plain sans form, approachable and wide-set.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-chivo: Cut-metal and confident. Chivo takes over below in sans-serif form, its lowercase packed close to the caps, daylight showing through every curve, while Stencilia handles the striking part.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur draws tall, rounded strokes with no thick-thin shift, like lengths of cord cut to size. And Stencilia does the striking work up top, leaving the body to carry the steady running text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hind-siliguri: Approachable is the first word for Hind Siliguri, but Stencilia gets the stage here, its structural gaps standing out. Hind Siliguri then fills the page with a flat gray hum of constant sans-serif line weight.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-kedebideri: Stencilia is the structural, striking half, with open gaps at its curve ends and a compact gap near the ascender line. Kedebideri is approachable and sans-serif, its rounded letters inviting.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable and modern, Miriam Libre writes with the weight of drawn wire, while Stencilia above it keeps a sign-painter's flat stencil look in its lines. Miriam Libre's tall lowercase holds up the text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-nokora: Structural, striking and cut open. Nokora follows with a wide-open s and a dark, heavy lowercase, so shrinking Stencilia would waste its gaps.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with an open, welcoming c and capitals barely above the lowercase. Stencilia earns its keep set big and short, where its structure shows.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Stencilia is structural and striking. Noto Sans Adlam, a clean sans-serif, keeps its curve endings well apart and its c, s and z tall, so it supports the heading without competing.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-baline: Structural and striking on top, then quiet below. But Noto Sans Balinese is the one built for reading, with breathing space inside each curve while Stencilia does the showy work.
